sections.content: You know *creo que* with the indicative and *no creo que* with the subjunctive from B1 Unit 13 (*opinion-verbs-mood*), and *dudo que* from B1 Unit 25. This lesson uses the same pattern with other verbs, such as *no pienso que* and *no parece que*, to reject or doubt an idea.

items.english: I don't think it is necessary.
I don't think he/she is right.

items.spanish: No creo que exista una única explicación.
items.english: I don't think there is a single explanation.

sections.content: Affirmative and negative flip the mood: *Creo que es necesario* (indicative) becomes *No creo que sea necesario* (subjunctive). The negation triggers the change, not the verb *creer*.
